ITEM 1 | Dark green broccoli florets, clustered heads with fine bumpy texture and some stems, matte surface, moist-looking, roughly 12-14 cm across the cluster, about 2-3 cm tall pile, sitting on the right and lower side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Mixed leafy greens: wilted and fresh dark green leaves, some flat spinach-like leaves and curled lettuce-like pieces, with reddish-purple edged leaves, glossy in places, lying in a loose mound about 15 cm across and 2-3 cm high in the upper-middle of the plate | 80
ITEM 3 | Single small whole cherry tomato, bright red, smooth glossy skin, about 2.5 cm diameter, sitting among the leaves near the center of the plate | 12
ITEM 4 | Thin pale green stem/vein pieces and a few small orange-brown bits, sparse, scattered among the leaves near the tomato | 3
